strategy.universe: All CRSP common stocks (shrcd 10/11) on NYSE, AMEX, and NASDAQ (point-in-time exchcd via dsenames)
strategy.signal: rolling market beta from a single 5-year monthly-return OLS regression, with no separate volatility/correlation windows and no Vasicek shrinkage
strategy.formation: each month split all stocks at the median estimated beta into a low-beta group and a high-beta group; within each group weight stocks by beta rank; both legs rescaled to unit beta at formation
strategy.position: long the low-beta group levered up by 1/beta_L (~$1.44 of exposure per $1 invested) and short the high-beta group de-levered by 1/beta_H (~$0.69 of exposure); BAB = (1/beta_L)*r_L - (1/beta_H)*r_H, a self-financing, market-neutral spread
strategy.weighting: rank-weighted within the low- and high-beta legs of the BAB factor; decile portfolios reported separately for descriptive analysis are equal-weighted using NYSE breakpoints
